mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY) = CAST(#{databaseName} AS BINARY) AND CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY) = CAST(#{objectName} AS BINARY) AND TABLE_TYPE IN ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW')

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS DATABASE_NAME, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY) = CAST(#{databaseName} AS BINARY) AND CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY) = CAST(#{objectName} AS BINARY) ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS DATABASE_NAME, TABLE_NAME AS OBJECT_NAME, TABLE_TYPE AS OBJECT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE IN ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW') AND ( ( @@lower_case_table_names = 0 AND CAST(TABLE_SCHEMA AS BINARY) = CAST(#{databaseName} AS BINARY) AND CAST(TABLE_NAME AS BINARY) = CAST(#{objectName} AS BINARY) ) OR ( @@lower_case_table_names IN (1, 2) AND CAST(LOWER(TABLE_SCHEMA) AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(#{databaseName}) AS BINARY) AND CAST(LOWER(TABLE_NAME) AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(#{objectName}) AS BINARY) ) )
